scope: Hatch full redesign — login and home surfaces, light and dark themes, anti-slop system, brand accent #E5173A, sticky saved-entries filters. Verified with a labeled development preview harness (illustrative fixtures) plus the real login route.

checks.state: Signed out, centered login card
checks.observed: Brand mark, "Sign in" heading, teal "Continue with Google" button with the Google mark, and helper text render on a plain light ground. No gradients, glass, blobs or decorative illustration. Focus order begins at the brand link and button.

checks.state: Token generated successfully
checks.observed: Two-column workspace: form card (Patente, Application segmented control with TAS active in the single teal accent, Terminal, Role, Generate/Save/Share) and result card (token box with copy, redirect URL with Open/Copy, metadata grid, Details disclosure). Saved entries below with search, role filter pills, application filter and rows. One accent hue, one grey family, no gradients or glass.

checks.state: Token generated successfully at a phone width
checks.observed: Single column stacks the form above the result. Header brand, Development badge and avatar fit without horizontal overflow; buttons are full width and every field fits the viewport.

checks.state: Token generated successfully at a tablet width
checks.observed: Single column below the lg breakpoint; the sm button row applies and the workspace stays readable with no overflow.

checks.state: Token request in flight
checks.observed: Result panel shows a skeleton matching the result shape, a "Generating token…" status and a disabled primary button with a spinner. The rest of the page stays stable.

checks.state: Token request failed
checks.observed: Result panel shows an inline error alert with a "Try again" action; no raw error dump and no page-level crash.

checks.state: No saved entries
checks.observed: Empty saved-entries state uses a dashed container, an icon and guidance to save a configuration; the counter reads 0 of 0 and the search and filters remain available.

checks.state: Settings panel open
checks.observed: Settings opens as a right-side panel with an Environment section (production toggle and warning) and an Account section (profile, email, sign out). The overlay dims the page and the panel is reachable.

checks.state: Saved entry delete confirmation open
checks.observed: The destructive "Delete" action uses a soft red outline style, clearly distinct from the solid brand-red primary "Generate token" button. "Cancel" is a neutral ghost action, so primary and destructive intents are not confusable now that the accent is red.

checks.state: Page scrolled to y=650 on a 1440x900 viewport
checks.observed: The "Saved entries" heading, counter, search field and filter pills/select stick below the 56px app header while the entry list scrolls beneath them. The sticky bar has an opaque background and a bottom border, so rows do not show through.

checks.state: Page scrolled to y=900 on a 390x844 viewport
checks.observed: On a phone width the heading and filters remain stuck below the header; the description is hidden to keep the bar compact, and the search, role pills and application filter stay reachable while the list scrolls under them.

checks.state: Saved-entry row hover and click
checks.observed: Hovering the row applies a light background and pointer cursor, indicating it is clickable. A mouse click on the patente text (outside the buttons) triggered the "Using ABCD1234" toast, so the whole row activates Use. Clicking the delete icon opened the Delete/Cancel confirmation without triggering Use. The Use button itself still works and is keyboard focusable.
steps: Navigated to the preview route and scrolled the first saved-entry row into view.
Hovered the row and captured the highlight state.
Dispatched a mouse click on the patente text, outside the buttons.
Confirmed the "Using ABCD1234" toast appeared (row click activates Use).
Clicked the delete icon and confirmed the Delete/Cancel actions appeared with no "Using" toast.

checks.state: Primary action focused with the keyboard
checks.observed: After dispatching 8 Tab key events, document.activeElement is the "Generate token" button and matches(":focus-visible") is true. The teal button shows a white focus ring with a teal offset, clearly visible against the fill.
steps: Dispatched 9 Tab key events through CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent.
Confirmed document.activeElement is the "Generate token" button and matches(":focus-visible") is true.

checks.state: Signed out, centered login card in dark mode
checks.observed: Dark zinc-950 ground, zinc-900 card with a zinc-800 border, brand mark with its subtle inner border, "Sign in" heading, red "Continue with Google" CTA and a theme toggle in the top right. No gradients or glow.

checks.state: Token generated successfully in dark mode
checks.observed: Two-column workspace on a zinc-950 ground with zinc-900 cards and zinc-800 borders. One grey family (zinc) and one accent (#E5173A); Token, Local portal and Redirect URL remain readable and the theme toggle shows the Sun icon.

checks.state: Token generated successfully at a phone width in dark mode
checks.observed: Single column stacks cleanly on a 390x844 dark viewport with no horizontal overflow; the header fits the brand, Development badge, theme toggle and avatar.

checks.state: Token request failed in dark mode
checks.observed: Inline error alert uses a dark red surface and red-200 text with a "Try again" action, readable against the dark card.

checks.state: Settings panel open in dark mode
checks.observed: Right-side panel renders on a zinc-900 surface with zinc-800 dividers, environment toggle and account card.

checks.state: Saved entry delete confirmation open in dark mode
checks.observed: The destructive "Delete" button uses a subtle dark-red outline style, distinct from the solid brand-red primary button.

checks.state: Page scrolled to y=650 in dark mode
checks.observed: The "Saved entries" heading and filters stick below the dark header with an opaque zinc-950 background and a bottom border.

checks.state: Header theme toggle clicked from light to dark
checks.observed: Clicking the header theme toggle adds the "dark" class to documentElement, saves "dark" to localStorage, updates the button aria-label from "Switch to dark mode" to "Switch to light mode" and re-themes the entire surface without a reload.
steps: Opened the preview in light mode (darkClass: false, stored: "light").
Dispatched a mouse click on the header theme toggle button.
Verified documentElement.classList.contains("dark") is true, localStorage.getItem("theme") is "dark", and the button aria-label changed to "Switch to light mode".

unresolved: target-generation: the authorized image-generation service returned "Insufficient account funds" for both target requests, so no generated target exists and no 1:1 target comparison is claimed.

authenticated-home-render: the real home surface needs a Google/Supabase session and the TAS/DPE backend; verification used the labeled development preview harness with illustrative fixtures, not the authenticated app.
screen-reader-audit: no VoiceOver/NVDA session was run; semantic roles and live regions were implemented and code-reviewed but not assistive-technology audited.
eslint: the project ESLint config fails to load a rule because of a pre-existing dependency version mismatch; TypeScript and the production build pass.
